title: Support
intro: Follow your cases or send a new request to support.
assistantBody: TasksNearMe Help answers right away from the help center, and gets you a person from our team when you need one.
emptyBody: Your requests, problem reports and safety reports appear here. Use the form below to ask support for help.
requestHint: Tell us what happened and what you need help with.
topicHint: Choose what your request is about.
bookingHint: Choose a recent booking if this request is about one.
descriptionHint: Use 20 to 2,000 characters. Include the details support needs to understand your request.
photosHint: Add up to 4 photos, up to {megabytes} MB each. Use JPEG, PNG, WebP or HEIC. Avoid house numbers, mail, and faces.
